title: Line sketch: Psychedelic Swirl Symphony
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The artwork displays a dense field of organic, flowing swirls and marbled shapes that twist and overlap in continuous motion across the entire frame. Bold color bands create layered depth and rhythmic patterns with no focal point, emphasizing pure visual energy. The technique suggests fluid pouring or digital simulation of liquid marbling with crisp edges and saturated gradients (derived from painting #141).
